info.title: Hyphen API
info.description: Knowledge explorer REST API. Monetary values use the network's smallest base unit. Hashes are hex-encoded strings. Endpoint descriptions indicate whether each route is backed by a committed index snapshot, a live capability snapshot, or a derived server-side view. Optional index and live routes return 501 when the required capability is disabled and 503 until the required dataset is ready.

get.description: Requires the optional address/spent index. Returns a derived address summary assembled from indexed chain facts rather than a Core RPC passthrough payload.

Requires the optional address/spent index. Returns mined address transaction history from one committed spent-index snapshot, including address-relative movement and block time, and does not mix in live mempool state.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior page.

get.summary: List unspent outputs for an address.
get.description: Requires the optional address/spent index. Returns spendable outputs from one committed spent-index snapshot.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior page.

get.description: Requires the optional address/spent index. This is a server-side ranked balance view, not a Core RPC concept. `includedSupply` is derived from the same spent-ledger snapshot as the returned balances and should be used for concentration calculations instead of combining this endpoint with `/api/v1/metrics/latest`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior page.

get.summary: Get a single block by height or hash.
get.description: Backed by the committed block index. Hash lookups can also resolve stored orphan blocks from one committed index snapshot. The nested live object is nullable, not snapshot-bound, and may be ahead of asOfHeight.
Backed by the committed block and transaction indices. Returns canonical mined block transactions only from one committed snapshot.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior page.

get.description: Backed by the committed block index. Returns canonical block summaries from one committed index snapshot. The nested live object is nullable, not snapshot-bound, and may be ahead of asOfHeight.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior page.

get.summary: Get the current mempool summary snapshot.
get.description: Requires the live mempool capability. Returns the current live mempool snapshot and is not backed by the historical chain index.
Requires the live mempool capability. Returns live mempool transactions only, not indexed chain history. If the live ISLock capability is enabled, transaction tags include current ISLock state.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior page.

get.description: Requires the optional metrics index. Returns derived historical chart points from the metrics index.

parameters.name: blocks
parameters.description: Lookback window in blocks from the current metrics tip.

get.summary: Get the latest block metrics snapshot.
get.description: Requires the optional metrics index. Returns derived chain statistics rather than live Core RPC passthrough values.
Requires the live network capability. Returns the current live network snapshot and is not backed by an indexed historical dataset.

get.summary: Get one governance proposal by hash.
get.description: Requires the live governance capability. Returns the current live proposal record, not a historical indexed governance timeline.

get.summary: Get current votes for one governance proposal.
get.description: Requires the live governance capability. Returns the current live vote set for one proposal and is not backed by a historical governance index.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior page.

get.description: Requires the live governance capability. Returns the current live governance object set and is not backed by a historical governance index.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior page.

get.summary: Get the raw serialized block as a hex string.
get.description: Backed by the block index plus local raw block storage. Returns serialized raw blocks from local storage rather than live Core passthrough RPC. This is a raw payload route, not a live overlay route.

get.summary: Get the raw serialized transaction as a hex string.
get.description: Backed by the transaction index plus local raw block storage. This is a raw payload route. If a txid is not indexed and the live mempool capability is enabled, the server can fall back to a live raw mempool transaction.

get.summary: Search for up to 10 typed autocomplete suggestions.
get.description: Server-specific cross-domain autocomplete over indexed and live-backed data. Exact full 64-hex queries may resolve either stored-endian form, but partial matching only uses canonical display identifiers. Suggestions are capped at 10 results and shorter than 3 characters return an empty list.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term for autocomplete suggestions and exact object lookups.

get.summary: Get daemon sync and indexing status.
get.description: Server-specific readiness and stage status view. Does not require any optional index to exist, but reports which indices and live capabilities are enabled and whether they are ready.

get.summary: Stream live NDJSON events over chunked HTTP.
get.description: Requires the live stream capability. Event payloads are server-specific live stream envelopes sourced from enabled ZMQ-fed and RPC-fed pipelines, not from any indexed snapshot.

200.description: Chunked NDJSON stream of live events

get.description: Primarily backed by the committed transaction index. The nested live object is nullable, not snapshot-bound, and may be ahead of asOfHeight. If a txid is not indexed and the live mempool capability is enabled, the server falls back to live mempool state.
Backed by the committed transaction index. Returns canonical mined transactions only from one committed snapshot.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior page.

get.description: Requires the optional validator index. Returns validator detail and special transaction history from the validator index. The nested live object is nullable, not snapshot-bound, may be ahead of asOfHeight, and may include live type, valid/status, pose, and last-paid overlay fields. Validator type is normalized for API responses.

Requires the optional validator index. Returns validator registry state materialized from indexed chain data. The nested live object is nullable, not snapshot-bound, may be ahead of asOfHeight, and may include live type, valid/status, pose, and last-paid overlay fields. Validator type is normalized for API responses.

tags.name: Blocks
tags.description: Canonical block views backed by committed block-index snapshots. These are not live RPC passthrough views.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Canonical transaction views backed by the transaction index, with explicit live mempool and ISLock fallbacks only where documented.

tags.name: Addresses
tags.description: Address history, UTXO, and ranked balance views backed by the optional address/spent index. Some fields are derived aggregations rather than raw Core RPC outputs.

tags.name: Metrics
tags.description: Derived chain statistics backed by the optional metrics index.

tags.name: Mempool
tags.description: Live mempool views backed by the live mempool capability and not by indexed chain history.

tags.name: Live
tags.description: Streaming HTTP feed of live event payloads sourced from enabled live pipelines.

tags.name: Network
tags.description: Live network snapshot backed by the live network capability.

tags.name: Governance
tags.description: Live governance proposal and vote views backed by the live governance capability, not by a historical governance index.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Cross-domain resolver that combines committed indexed datasets with enabled live capabilities.
